'''Skoblins''' are summoned by [[Strongbones]] during the quest [[Land of the Goblins]] and the miniquest [[Hopespear's Will]]. They will not be summoned if [[Protect from Summoning|Protect from]]/[[Deflect Summoning]] is activated. If you activate Protect from/Deflect Summoning after the Skoblins have been summoned, the damage they do will be nullified.
